Report of Academic andAdministrative Audit (AAA)
          Ramkrishna Nagar College : Ramkrishna Nagar : Karimganj.
   1. Introduction: On request of the Principal of Ramkrishna Nagar College,
        Vide letter No.OP/RKNC/MISC/AUS/2023/A-B dated 13.04.2023 a team of
        two member committee formed consisting of Dr. Ashok Kumar Das,
        Principal, Rabindra Sadan Girls College and Dr. Himadri Sekhar Das,
        Professor, Department of Physics, Assam University, Silchar for Academic
        and Administrative Audit of the college. The members of the AAA
        committee visited the college on 29th May 2023 and conducted the detailed
        audit through reviewing, assessing and evaluating academic and
        administrative aspects of the college based on a set of criterion and
        suggested measures for building up all important aspects of the college. The
        team interacted with the Principal, 1QAC Team, GB members, Teaching &
        Non-Teaching staff and other stakeholders on various aspects of the college.
        The team inspected available facilities of the college verified & scrutinised
         allimportant related documents.
   2. Programme schedule of AAA visit: - The schedule of programme of AAA
      visit which was prepared in consultation with the principal of the college
        was as follows.

Time:                              Programme
10:00 AM:        Welcome meeting with the principal and others.
10:15 AM:         Presentation of report by Principal of the college.The report
                  covers the brief introduction of the college and broadly highlights
                  the important aspects covering all the seven key indicator of
                   NAACaccreditation.
11:15 AM :        Visit to selected Department, interaction and document
                 verification.

12:30 PM:        Interaction with different stakeholders represented by
                 managenment, teaching and Non-teaching staff, students,
                parents and alumni.
2:00 PM:      Visit to library, various lab (computer lab, Language lab,
               Science lab), Canteen, sports and other facilities
3:20 PM:       Report Preparation
4:00 PM:       Submission of AAA report and exist meeting in presence
                of principal,teacher, IQAC Co-ordinator and other
                members as decided by the college

   3.   General information about Ramkrishna Nagar College :
      Ramkrishna Nagar College was established in 1964, the college was
brought under Deficit Grants-in-Aid system in the year 1998. The college came
under provincialization programme of Assam Government in 2005. The college is
recognised by UGCunder section 12(t) and 12(B) of the UGCAct 1956 on & from
on February, 2000. The college has been accredited by NAAC and is
                                                                  now going
for 2nd cycle of NAAC Accreditation.

       The College is affiliated to Assam University, Silchar and offers various
Programmes like Higher Secondary courses, Bachelor of Arts (B.A) and Bachelor'
of Science (B.Sc). The College has Nine (9) Departments in B.A
                                                               stream and Three
(3) Departments in B.Sc course. The Departments in Arts stream are;
                                                                        English,
Bengali, Sanskrit, Hindi, Economics, Political Science, History, Sociology and
Philosophy. On the other hand, the Departments viz. Physics, Chemistry,
Mathematics are in B.Sc course. Students can opt. for Honours (Core) subject in
English, Bengali, Economics, Political Science, Physics and Mathematics'. In
addition to the above, courses, college is also engaged in offering Diploma Course
Programme in Sanskrit under Central Sanskrit University.
